confirm.title: Rewrite the recorded statistics units
confirm.description:
{count} entities report a unit that differs from the one their long-term statistics were recorded under. Home Assistant stops recording when that happens, so these meters go flat on the energy dashboard with nothing said about why.

This rewrites the statistics metadata to the unit each entity now reports. History is kept; only the unit recorded against it changes.
